caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair is illustrated in a reddish-brown color, showing wood grain details and shading that suggest dimension and texture. The chair has a solid seat, two horizontal back slats, and four sturdy legs, all rendered in the same reddish-brown hue. The background is blank, with no additional objects or patterns, drawing focus solely to the chair as the subject of the composition.
title: Doll Furniture - Chair
